summary.name: qingzhu.cn
summary.one_liner: A domain-for-sale page offering the qingzhu.cn domain name, with purchase and owner-contact forms that redirect to Spaceship.
use_cases: Making an offer to buy the qingzhu.cn domain
Finding out if qingzhu.cn is available for purchase
Completing a domain name purchase with guided transfer
summary.what_it_does: The page is a sale listing for the domain qingzhu.cn. Visitors fill in basic personal information to submit an offer, then are redirected to spaceship.com to negotiate and pay. A separate form lets visitors message the owner, with replies handled on spaceship.com. The page states free transaction support, secure payments, and no hidden fees. It does not describe any content or service hosted on the domain itself.
notable: Sale is handled through Spaceship, with checkout and transfer support
Offers and owner messages are submitted via a form and continued on spaceship.com
Listed in hanishrao/collective-ai-tools under 'Presentation' as Qingzhu Office, a Word/PDF conversion and PPT tool (#paid)
caveats: Listing price is not shown on the page; negotiation happens on spaceship.com
The page does not describe the Qingzhu Office tool; the repository listing names it, but this URL only sells the domain
